programme.title: El disputado voto del Sr. Cayo
programme.desc: A Rafael, un joven diputado socialista, le comunican la muerte de su amigo Víctor Velasco y el cementerio coincide con Laly, una antigua compañera. Ambos rememoran la personalidad del amigo fallecido y comparten muchos momentos juntos.

programme.title: El año de las luces
programme.desc: En la primavera de 1940, dos muchachos con síntomas de tuberculosis son enviados a un sanatorio cerca de la frontera portuguesa. Durante su estancia allí, Manolo, el mayor de los dos, vive su despertar sexual.

programme.title: El Grano de mostaza
programme.desc: Durante una partida de dominó, Evelino Galindo, propietario de una tienda de porcelanas, mantiene con un compañero de juego una agria discusión que casi desemboca en tragedia, ya que reta a muerte a su adversario.

programme.title: Guerreros
programme.desc: Kosovo, invierno de 2000, después del bombardeo de la OTAN. Las fuerzas de la KFOR desempeñan su tarea humanitaria y técnica tratando de mantener una difícil neutralidad a medio camino entre los albanokosovares y los serbios.

programme.title: Miss Caribe

programme.title: Los hombres siempre mienten
programme.desc: A Martín lo expulsan de la escuela. El azar hace que un vecino, un escritor famoso, le dé las llaves de su piso para que se lo cuide. Martín encuentra el manuscrito de su última novela y la presenta en la escuela como si fuera obra suya.

programme.title: Cha-cha-chá
programme.desc: Lucía y María son dos amigas jóvenes y guapas que se conocen desde niñas y lo comparten todo menos una cosa: Pablo, el novio de María, quien también es joven y bastante guapo. Tanto que a Lucía le encanta y lo ama en secreto.

programme.title: Más allá del jardín
programme.desc: La noche que celebra sus 25 años de matrimonio, Palmira se replantea la totalidad de su vida, a causa de una sucesión de hechos dolorosos. Esta crisis determinará que la mujer tome la decisión de convertirse en misionera laica.

programme.title: Tengo 17 años
programme.desc: Rocío decide huir de su casa cuando descubre que su madrastra no la quiere, parando en un modesto hogar donde conoce a David y se enamora de él, pero para que este pueda estar con ella, primero deberá superar tres pruebas.

programme.desc: no info available

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
programme.desc: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Always Money in Philadelphia
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, the guys face a shady bidder with inside information and former NFL star Vince Papale in a battle for a vintage football passing machine and a colonial musket that could be worth huge money if it's real.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: With Ton missing, Allen struggles to keep the pawn shop afloat while training Elle to work an auction. After a fierce bidding war with Caroline, pieces from a century old motorcycle may not be enough to save the day. ed.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
programme.desc: 1800s blackpowder whaling harpoon; 1940s Schwinn Town & Country tandem bicycle; a vintage American flag collection that could be worth thousands.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Flying Ton, Creeping Allen
programme.desc: When a group of thugs try to bully Ton and Allen out of a Chinatown auction, the guys fight back, leading to a violent showdown and the discovery of both a rare Bornean blowgun and special effects wire harnesses.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Missouri Loves Company
programme.desc: On a visit to see Ton's sister in Missouri for some rafting and relaxation, the guys hit up a fast-paced live auction. After some tough losses, Ton and Allen score a ballista and an anvil set made for an explosive sport.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams
programme.desc: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Brew-Phoria
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go all in for an electric car, but with the batteries missing, a pricey refurb is their only shot at a profit. Will a home brewing system and high-end air rifles help soften the blow, or will they take a big loss?

programme.title: Auction Hunters: You Got Served

programme.desc: Veinte años después de la Tercera Guerra Mundial, en un ambiente post apocalíptico en el que Conan, un pequeño chico pescador que junto con su abuelo, son los únicos supervivientes en su "isla perdida".

programme.title: La mesa amarilla

programme.title: Pili y el guardián enmascarado
programme.desc: Pili, una niña muy curiosa, usa toda su inteligencia para ayudar al Guardián Enmascarado, un superhéroe poco convencional, a librarse del malvado D.Sastre y así salvar al planeta Tierra.

programme.title: Haciendo discos

programme.title: Andalucía a dedo
programme.desc: Andalucía a dedo es un programa de viajes y relatos humanos protagonizado por el periodista Nacho Medina. Con una mochila, un operador de cámara y sin dinero, recorre Andalucía haciendo autostop y dejando que sean las personas que encuentra por el camino quienes decidan el rumbo de cada aventura. Sin guion previo ni destino establecido, cada episodio se convierte en una experiencia única en la que afloran conversaciones espontáneas, historias de superación, recuerdos, tradiciones y vivencias que muestran la cara más auténtica y solidaria de Andalucía. Agricultores, camioneros, familias, jóvenes o inmigrantes comparten parte de su vida con el equipo, transformando cada trayecto en un retrato cercano de la realidad andaluza. Un formato que combina viaje, emoción e improvisación para descubrir la riqueza humana de una tierra donde el destino lo marcan las personas.

programme.title: Code and the kiln's glow
programme.desc: For a thousand years, Jingdezhen's kiln fires have shaped iconic ceramics and a living cultural heritage. Today, algorithms are joining the craftsmen -- helping piece together broken ceramics and give each piece a digital ID. In this episode of Living with AI, CGTN reporter He Jingyi explores how AI can help preserve ancient craftsmanship -- and how governance can keep pace when the oldest traditions meet the newest technology.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how? Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art. In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Biztalk Special Coverage on AI EP3
programme.desc: The Token Economy Demand for AI tokens is surging, with trends like “tokenmaxxing” accelerating the race for computing power. As pressure mounts on computing and energy infrastructure, China is leveraging its clean energy strengths to support AI growth, while “token exports” emerge as a new way to deliver AI services to global users. What’s the future like for the “token economy”? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the economics behind the AI revolution.

Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art. In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: Biztalk Special Coverage on AI EP3
programme.desc: The Token Economy Demand for AI tokens is surging, with trends like “tokenmaxxing” accelerating the race for computing power. As pressure mounts on computing and energy infrastructure, China is leveraging its clean energy strengths to support AI growth, while “token exports” emerge as a new way to deliver AI services to global users. What’s the future like for the “token economy”? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the economics behind the AI revolution.

When the world's two biggest economies click, everyone benefits.

programme.title: The Lights of Yuxian County
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Yuxian County, Hebei Province, to celebrate the Lunar New Year. We watch the Shehuo folk parade, sample local street‑food treats, witness the spectacular Dashuhua molten‑iron fireworks show, and join the mysterious Baidengshan worship ritual as we experience a traditional northern‑style Spring Festival in Yuxian County.

programme.title: Fearless Journey Ep.5
programme.desc: Ten outdoor enthusiasts take on the world through various sports ---- from marathons to cycling ---- experiencing geography, culture, history, and the spirit of athletics.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou's traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China's national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors - but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: New Year with the Miao
programme.desc: In this episode, it's Miao New Year, and that means multitudes of merrymaking! Fishing, drinking, bullfighting... Join the host Min-Zhui Lee, among the magnificent mountains of Leishan, where it's all happening for the ethnic Miao.

programme.title: Aerial China III Ep.5
programme.desc: Tianjin is a city whose waterways all converge in one place: the Haihe River. Indeed, you could say that, in a sense, this river is a living, flowing chronicler of China's metamorphosis - the golden thread that traces a century of history from the Grand Canal to the open vistas of the country's ocean-going future.

programme.title: From bean to cup: The rise of China's specialty coffee
programme.desc: Pu'er, a city named after tea, is now at the center of another brewing story: China's fast-rising coffee industry. From mountain farms to urban cafés, a new generation of growers and coffee professionals is bringing China's specialty coffee onto the global stage. What makes Yunnan's coffee region unique? How are farmers, industry professionals, and consumers shaping a new coffee ecosystem in China? Join us as we explore how China's coffee culture is evolving - from origin to cup.

programme.title: A Bite of China II Ep.5
programme.desc: In this much-anticipated sequel to the acclaimed foodie hit, we take an even closer look at the bond between Chinese people and food. Featuring around 150 characters and 300 different delicacies, we stand to witness to the role food plays in life's key moments. In short, this series offers the most flavorful insight into ancient Chinese culture that you are ever going to get!

programme.title: Gourmets Alive Ep.5
programme.desc: What did China's most celebrated scholars and poets eat? This documentary follows the trail of famous cultural figures from ancient to modern times, using reenactments to explore the classic dishes that helped define China’s rich culinary history.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature. Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Foodwise: Veggie Beijing
programme.desc: Beijing is a 3000-year old metropolis home to a dizzying array of culinary traditions, not least of which is vegetarian cuisine. For Beijingers, eating vegetarian is the best way to welcome spring. In this episode, Tianran and Angela take up the challenge: From simple home cooking utilizing spring flowers and leaves, to the extravagant mock-meat masterpieces of imperial cuisine, and international dishes well-known to the vegetarian community, our hosts discover a plethora of plant-based options to be found amongst the historic alleys and skyscrapers of China's capital.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN's Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, "Fun Guide to China". Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port. From the world's largest stand-alone duty-free mall - a true shopper's paradise, to the laid-back charm of an "Old Dad Tea" restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach. The journey then heads west to Danzhou, where campervans and "mermaids" share the same stage, before reaching Wanning on the east coast, where Tianran catches waves at one of China's most famous surfing hotspots.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique "rock rhyme" (yan yun) - a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. programme.title: You'll be amazed by Nanjing's fusion of old and new
programme.desc: Though it may not be as well-known as Beijing or Shanghai, China's eastern city of Nanjing is proud of its glorious past, and many of its old quarters are now some of the city's hottest destinations. From ancient pagodas and futuristic skyscrapers to Buddhist temples, take a look at this snapshot of a multi-faceted city.

programme.title: A Bite of China II Ep.6
programme.desc: In this much-anticipated sequel to the acclaimed foodie hit, we take an even closer look at the bond between Chinese people and food. In short, this series offers the most flavorful insight into ancient Chinese culture that you are ever going to get!

programme.title: Gourmets Alive Ep.6
programme.desc: What did China's most celebrated scholars and poets eat? This documentary follows the trail of famous cultural figures from ancient to modern times, using reenactments to explore the classic dishes that helped define China’s rich culinary history.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN's Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, "Fun Guide to China". Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port. From the world's largest stand-alone duty-free mall - a true shopper's paradise, to the laid-back charm of an "Old Dad Tea" restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach. The journey then heads west to Danzhou, where campervans and "mermaids" share the same stage, before reaching Wanning on the east coast, where Tianran catches waves at one of China's most famous surfing hotspots.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: el contraataque
programme.desc: "Los héroes americanos más grandes" están de regreso y han sido culpados de un crimen atroz que no cometieron. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) dirige a un nuevo equipo en esta explosiva aventura.

programme.title: La estafa maestra
programme.desc: Tras ser traicionados y abandonados a su suerte en Italia, Charlie Croker y su equipo planean un elaborado robo de oro contra su antiguo aliado.

programme.title: Terminator 2: juicio final
programme.desc: La máquina no humana que domina la élite del futuro devastado por la guerra despacha un cíborg asesino al pasado para matar a un jovencito porque pronto será el líder de la resistencia en contra de la máquina.

programme.title: Terminator: Destino oculto
programme.desc: Un súper soldado mejorado se une a la combatiente Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton) y un aliado inesperado (Arnold Schwarzenegger) para detener al Terminator más mortífero hasta el momento.

programme.title: La estafa maestra
programme.desc: Tras ser traicionados y abandonados a su suerte en Italia, Charlie Croker y su equipo planean un elaborado robo de oro contra su antiguo aliado.

programme.title: Un plan infalible
programme.desc: Un ingenioso trío de ladrones disfrazados debe luchar por sus vidas y el botín cuando un verdadero criminal maestro los chantajea para que planifiquen y ejecuten un atraco de $20 millones. Protagonizada por Ryan Reynolds.

programme.title: Contract Killers
programme.desc: Traicionado por aquellos en los que más confiaba, un asesino a sueldo novato del gobierno descubre que es el objetivo del asesino más peligroso del mundo y así comienza un despiadado juego de matar primero o morir.

programme.title: War of the world annihilation
programme.desc: Tras una dura invasión alienígena, la única esperanza de supervivencia de una madre y su hijo reside en descubrir una verdad impensable.

programme.title: Keoma
programme.desc: Un veterano mestizo de la Unión intenta proteger su pueblo natal, asolado por la peste, de sus hermanastros racistas y de un tirano confederado.

programme.title: El Hombre del Presidente
programme.desc: Un agente secreto altamente clasificado del presidente de Estados Unidos debe encontrar un intrépido sustituto que se haga cargo de sus peligrosísimas misiones militares.

programme.title: Titanic II
programme.desc: Un siglo después del fatídico viaje del original, zarpa el moderno transatlántico de lujo Titanic II. ¿Sufrirá este barco el mismo destino que su homónimo?

programme.title: Piel
programme.desc: Un notorio skinhead se enamora de una mujer y sus tres hijas, y se somete a dolorosos tratamientos para eliminar los tatuajes que cubren todo su rostro y cuerpo, la representación física del odio que mostró al mundo durante más de la mitad de su vida. Basada en la historia real de Bryon Widner.

programme.title: AVH: Alien vs. Hunter : NE PAS UTILISER CAR MIRE
programme.desc: Un cazador galáctico persigue a su presa más mortífera del universo.

programme.title: Battledogs
programme.desc: Un virus de hombre lobo se desata sobre Nueva York, y el Mayor Hoffman busca una cura mientras el Teniente General Monning quiere establecer un nuevo ejército canino.

programme.title: Breach
programme.desc: A punto de convertirse en padre, un joven mecánico a bordo de un arca interestelar rumbo a la Nueva Tierra debe ingeniárselas para vencer a un terror cósmico maligno que pretende usar la nave espacial como arma.

programme.title: Los Supervivientes

programme.desc: Al and Peggy delay going to a closing of their favorite hamburger joint, Johnny Be Good's, when Bud and Kelly need them to solve their own problems. Meanwhile, Steve and Marcy prepare a party for their bosses at home.

programme.title: Married... With Children
programme.desc: Al is reluctant to have Buck neutered despite being threatened with lawsuits from numerous neighbors regarding Buck's "nocturnal carnal activities.”

programme.title: Married... With Children
programme.desc: The Bundys take a vacation to near-beautiful Dumpwater, Florida and stay in a cut-rate motel where an ax murderer that hates tourists shows up every five years since 1967.

programme.title: Married... With Children
programme.desc: After a hair-raising encounter with the maniac, Al decides to get the family out of town. But, they are trapped at the motel by a storm and the locals are unwilling to help them.

programme.title: Married... With Children
programme.sub-title: If I Were a Rich Man

programme.title: Married... With Children

programme.title: My Three Sons
programme.desc: Steve's former sweetheart is now a princess.

programme.title: My Three Sons
programme.desc: Bub joins a women's group to save a tree.

programme.title: My Three Sons
programme.desc: When Robbie's class harasses a substitute teacher, he gets into a lot of trouble at home.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Viajamos con Lety Zetune, experta en experiencias de lujo y agente de viajes de NUBA, nominada como una de las mejores agencias de México. Con ella, descubrimos por qué viajar no solo es una forma de conocer el mundo, sino también de reconectar contigo mismo.Desde los mejores destinos para una despedida de soltera, hasta los rincones más exóticos para una luna de miel, Lety nos guía a través de los secretos de planear un viaje inolvidable. En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La talentosa actriz Majo Pérez nos abre las puertas de su mundo artístico y emocional. Majo relata cómo descubrió su pasión por la actuación, sus inicios en los escenarios y cómo el teatro se convirtió en su refugio. A lo largo de la entrevista, Majo reflexiona sobre los nervios que nunca desaparecen antes de salir a escena, los desafíos de interpretar personajes complejos, como su inolvidable papel de Sally Bowles en "Cabaret", y las experiencias incómodas que pueden surgir frente al público. Con sensibilidad, honestidad y carisma, Majo revela cómo ha roto moldes al interpretar roles tradicionalmente masculinos y cómo el escenario le ha permitido conocerse profundamente. Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. - Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. - Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: El reconocido director Chava Espinosa, nos revela los secretos detrás de la dirección de series y películas que han marcado tendencia en la televisión y el streaming. Con una trayectoria que inició desde el catering hasta llegar a la dirección de producciones icónicas como "Club de Cuervos", Chava comparte su evolución profesional con honestidad y buen humor. El episodio ofrece una mirada privilegiada al proceso creativo del director: desde el manejo de actores, el arte de construir comedia, hasta la presión de las premieres y el impacto del público en el resultado final. Además, reflexiona sobre el futuro del cine independiente, los cambios de la industria tras la pandemia y sus deseos de incursionar en géneros como la acción, el terror y la ciencia ficción. Una conversación dinámica, divertida e inspiradora con uno de los nombres clave en la nueva generación de directores en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Recibimos al irreverente y entrañable Mauricio Barrientos “Diablito”, actor, conductor, comediante y figura clave del entretenimiento en México. Entre risas, anécdotas y reflexiones honestas, Diablito nos muestra su lado más humano y auténtico, más allá del personaje que todos conocemos. Desde sus inicios en TV Azteca, hasta su participación en telenovelas, reality shows y programas de comedia, exploramos cómo ha evolucionado su carrera y su voz como artista. Un episodio entre la carcajada y la introspección, con un invitado que ha logrado mantenerse vigente rompiendo esquemas, sin perder su esencia.

programme.desc: A man (Alan Rosenberg) whom Catherine flirted with at a bar reappears in her life as a suspect in a murder investigation of a woman who was shot and killed.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Two amorous freshmen are found dead in a sleeping bag in a dorm room, and Sara and Greg run into one dead end after another as they try to determine why the students were killed.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Catherine investigan la aparición de una pierna cortada de un cuerpo en un lago. Mientras tanto, Sara y Nick investigan un juramento de fraternidad que ha salido terriblemente mal.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Warrick toman el caso de un joven que es descubierto desnudo en el desierto sin una causa obvia de muerte.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Catherine viola el protocolo del departamento cuando acepta el caso de una acusación de violación contra su exmarido. Warrick y Sara buscan la bala perdida que exonerará o acusará a un policía de asesinato.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Cuando una adolescente y su hermana son las únicas supervivientes del espantoso asesinato de cuatro miembros de una familia en un tranquilo barrio suburbano, Grissom y todo su equipo investigan el crimen.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Royce Harmon fue asesinado hace 3 meses en una escena montada para que pareciera un suicidio. Ahora se ha producido otro asesinato.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y su equipo investigan la muerte de un pasajero de primera clase en un vuelo a Las Vegas.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Sara investigan un cuerpo plagado de bichos encontrado en el desierto. Warrick y Catherine investigan el robo de unas valiosas obras de arte.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una mujer es secuestrada en un supermercado. En la tienda, Grissom encuentra la puerta de un baño que dice que cinco mujeres han sido asesinadas.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Un preso condenado a muerte manda un video pidiendo ayuda a Gil, afirmando que es inocente de la muerte de su mujer y su hijo, Gill acepta el caso y con la ayuda de Sara y de Warrick intenta averiguar lo que de verdad sucedió en la casa.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una bomba explota en un edificio de oficinas matando a una persona e hiriendo a muchas más. El principal sospechoso es un guardia de seguridad que se marchó minutos antes de la explosión y que tiene conocimiento en la fabricación de bombas.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.sub-title: Reducir a la mitad y mantener
programme.desc: Cuando se descubre un único hueso humano en el desierto, Grissom y Catherine deben recorrer kilómetros de territorio para encontrar el resto del esqueleto.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: En una elegante recaudación de fondos, a la que asiste el sheriff, una mujer aparece muerta en la piscina.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una mujer es secuestrada en el aparcamiento de un centro comercial. Es violada, golpeada, disparada y dada por muerta. Sara recoge pruebas de ella y se encariña con ella.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Encuentran un cadáver en una tienda de cerámica en lo que parece ser un robo interrumpido.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una pareja que sale de un restaurante en su aniversario es asesinada en la calle y su coche es robado. La escena del crimen se ve comprometida cuando llueve poco después de que lleguen los CSI.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Todo el equipo investiga el secuestro del hijo pequeño de una familia acomodada. Las sospechas recaen inmediatamente sobre los padres del niño.

programme.title: Emergency Rescue: Air, Land and Sea: Northern Courage
programme.desc: Brave volunteers risk life and limb to rescue adventurers in the UK's perilous landscapes.

programme.title: Emergency Helicopter Medics
programme.desc: In Hartlepool, the heli-medics are tasked with treating a man hit by a train cyclist Trevor suffers serious injuries after a collision with a car motocross biker Arai in Cumbria is flown across the country for emergency surgery.

programme.title: Chopper Squad
programme.desc: A motocross rider may have broken his back after hitting a tree head-on at high speed at a sawmill, a man faces his worst nightmare a woman fights for her life.

programme.title: Send in the Dogs: Manchester Man Hunt
programme.desc: Manchester's car crime problem is tackled by PC Rogers and his German Shepherd Leo.

programme.title: UK Border Force
programme.desc: A suspected in a smash and grab heist at a jewelry store in Austria officers play spot the imposter in Lagos, Nigeria.

programme.title: UK Border Force
programme.desc: A man from Pakistan claiming to be a student is refused entry into Britain after two days of questioning.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.sub-title: The Man Who Talked to Dogs
programme.desc: When a dog trainer with celebrity clientele disappears, investigators track down a suspect with the help of two witnesses.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: A mystery in paradise unfolds when Sarm Heslop vanishes from her boyfriend's luxury yacht in the U.S. Virgin Islands; new details emerge on the case that made international headlines and left investigators with more questions than answers.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: Investigators look for answers when a popular school superintendent is found dead in his western New York home.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: When two Americans go missing in Panama, natives discover the dark side of a fun-loving bartender.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: Twenty-five years after a man involved in a love triangle is stabbed to death, detectives reopen the case.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: A look back at the 1997 murder of fashion designer Gianni Versace, including interviews with his long-time partner Antonio D'Amico, model Beverly Johnson, fashion journalist Hal Rubenstein, author Maureen Orth and more.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: When a Pennsylvania man who was convinced his messy divorce put a target on his back is found stabbed to death, his friends and family realize he was right all along in predicting his own gruesome murder.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: The children of an Oklahoma pastor survive the robbery that took their parents' lives and observe the trials of those accused of committing the crime.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: A 21-year-old college student is found murdered; the case remains cold for nearly 40 years until a new detective uses an innovative method to catch her killer.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: A couple goes on a scuba-diving vacation in the British Virgin Islands; on the final dive of the trip, one of them surfaces -- but the other does not.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: The discovery of an Army captain's death in her El Paso, Texas, home shakes her tight-knit military community.

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: A successful businesswoman and mother of three is found shot in her office; the investigation into her death leaves a family divided.

programme.desc: A look back at the 1997 murder of fashion designer Gianni Versace, including interviews with his long-time partner Antonio D'Amico, model Beverly Johnson, fashion journalist Hal Rubenstein, author Maureen Orth and more.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Psychopathic killers lurk in society, mostly acting alone. Sometimes fate brings them into contact with another person who shares their cold power to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women burn madly with jealousy, an anger so deep they’ll kill to satisfy it. What makes them turn from “green with envy” to “lethal with jealousy?" Find out as we explore their hearts of darkness.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Twisted Thrills
programme.desc: The intimate thoughts of a twisted mind would be enough to stun a community and horrify the world. But thoughts alone may not be enough to turn someone into a killer. This is a bizarre journey into the world of women who kill for twisted thrills.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Loathe Thy Neighbor
programme.desc: Neighbors can be a source of friendship and community comfort. But what happens when a neighbor stops watching out for you, and starts watching you. The sinister minds of these women begin to turn sour and they begin to torment their neighbors.

programme.title: Deadly Women: An Inconvenient Marriage
programme.desc: Love is a powerful emotion; it can drive women to unthinkable crimes of passion. Hate however, is love's gloomy shadow, and it can drive women into the darkest corners of their mind.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Sins of the Sister
programme.desc: A sisterly bond can mean a life full of friendship and sibling love. But for some women, having a sister means nothing more then having their own personal meal ticket, scapegoat and combatant. These types of relationships can lead to deadly outcomes.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Kill For Cash
programme.desc: Money is a strong motivator. It can be used for good. It can be used for evil. It can be the driving force behind murder. These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Deadly Delinquents
programme.desc: In the tormented mind of a young school girl, jealousy can turn to a murderous rage. These deadly girls turn on their own and kill their friends. This is the brutal world of deadly delinquents.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women who kill husbands, lovers, rivals and parents will shock society. But a very special horror is reserved for women who will kill their own.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outlaws.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Married to Murder
programme.desc: To the outside world, their marriages seemed happy. But behind closed doors, there was no domestic bliss. These women wanted out, but getting a divorce wasn’t their preferred option.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women never get their hands dirty: no blood touched them because they manipulate others to kill for them...but they didn't get away.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Under His Control
programme.desc: These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Rain Check
programme.desc: For Dog and Beth it's not only another day in paradise, it's their anniversary. Beth is hoping for a romantic dinner with her man, but she knows only too well that for Dog work always comes first.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Love on the Run
programme.desc: Today Dog finds himself looking for more than one fugitive. He starts the day looking for a woman who has skipped out on her court date. But he soon learns that she has teamed up with a woman whose criminal exploits have attracted the local media.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Jump Start
programme.desc: Dog gave a break to a young man with a drug problem who promised to enter drug rehab. But this commitment to rehabilitation seems to have ended when he bolted from the car on the way to the drug treatment center and went on the run.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Ice Man
programme.desc: Dog's latest fugitive doesn't think small when it comes to illegal drugs: he was carrying almost a pound of meth when he was arrested. Now he's on the run with his pregnant girlfriend on the high plains of Colorado.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Trouble in Paradise
programme.desc: Dog is back in Hawaii and tracking a dangerous fugitive through the jungles of the Big Island. Their prey is being protected by a ring of family and friends that Dog must forcefully confront to bring in his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Girl Power
programme.desc: When Dog decides to spend the day caring for his newest granddaughter, Beth enlists the girls to hunt down a female fugitive. Heading into a dangerous part of town the ladies will use their feminine wiles to track this mother gone wrong.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Prodigal Son
programme.desc: Dog and his old friends, Tim Chapman and Sonny Westbrook are riding with the team, so their target, a thief with violent tendencies, is out of luck. When Dog learns that the fugitive is also a disrespectful son, he is more motivated to find his man.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Family Ties
programme.desc: Dog doesn't have the whole team today and he's got to catch a fugitive with a record of criminal assault. But when Dog finds the fugitive's former girlfriend, she thinks he isn't dangerous at all.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Special Delivery
programme.desc: For months, this fugitive has been stringing Leland along with a series of barely believable excuses. Out of patience, Leland calls in the Big Dog. The whole team heads out to put pressure on the family and friends of the fugitive.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surface Scratches
programme.desc: Dog's latest quarry is running from abuse and assault charges. As Dog investigates, he discovers that this fugitive has gamed the system by jumping from one bond, and one bondsman, to another.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Great Debate
programme.desc: When the co-signer of a bond is also romantically involved with the defendant, sometimes the bondman is put in the middle of a lover's quarrel.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Facebooked
programme.desc: Dog is in Denver helping Bobby Brown to track down a fugitive with a long rap sheet. But unfortunately they have no picture of the felon to work with, so the challenges are big on this one. But Dog discovers a new source; "Facebook".

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mano-a-Mano
programme.desc: Back in Colorado, Dog's on the hunt for a runner with more than a decade's worth of trouble with the law. But the fugitive's friends and family are reluctant to help Dog bring him in.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown
programme.sub-title: The Road Show: Where Mercy is Shown
programme.desc: After releasing the second part of his autobiography, Dog and his family traveled across America, and this very special episode offers an intimate portrait of both the public and private moments of that journey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Comeback Kid
programme.desc: Dog is back in Colorado chasing a young man with a taste for trouble. He's fled to Texas but with his family's house on the line Dog is willing to try a risky strategy.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tent City
programme.desc: Today's hunt takes Dog far from the glittering hotels of Waikiki to the parts of Hawaii tourist rarely see, Oahu's ramshackle tent cities. The team searches for a woman who has lost almost everything, her home, her family and her spirit.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Dead of Night
programme.desc: Dog's good friend and fellow bondsman Chris is running out of time. He has only days to find his fugitive or risk losing his business. In his hunt Dog confronts duplicitous tipsters, vicious attack dogs, and hostile neighbors.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 1
programme.sub-title: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 1
programme.desc: Dog launches a high stake hunt through the desolate and dangerous mountain landscape of western Colorado in pursuit of a gun-loving survivalist with a million dollar bond on his head. Will Dog's plan of using brains over brawn work?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 2
programme.sub-title: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 2
programme.desc: Once in Montrose, Dog discovers that the million dollar fugitive is not the young bondsman's only problem. Dog and Beth make it their mission to both clean up the mess and teach him the fundamentals of bondsmanship.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: Round the Clock
programme.sub-title: The Montrose Files: Round the Clock
programme.desc: Dog is committed to saving his new friend's bail bonding business, and now must race against time to bring a rogues gallery to justice in the High Sierra mountain town of Montrose, CO.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: And Then There Were None
programme.sub-title: The Montrose Files: And Then There Were None
programme.desc: With four outlaws still on the lam, Dog sets out to bring 'em in. As day turns into night and with the darkness and the danger mounting, an undaunted Dog and team plan late night hits on the riskiest of locations--their targets' homes.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog finds himself fighting two enemies; the law and his inner demons. He continues his legal battle to fight extradition to Mexico in connection with his 2003 capture of fugitive rapist Andrew Luster. His other struggle is private.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: This fugitive is hard to pin down in Honolulu's downtown district, moving from hostel to hotel to apartment high-rise. But as the hunt evolves, Dog discovers that this alleged burglar isn't the only family member wanted by the law.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: A fugitive from justice is on the lam, and it's Dog's job to find him. When they hit the last known address, they discover he already has pulled up stakes and left no forwarding address. The posse's one hope is to locate his girlfriend.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When can a bounty hunt also be a date? When Dog and Beth decide to ride in the same SUV as they pursue a runaway fugitive, will their different approaches to the investigation lead to a capture and romance?

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: It's Christmas day, and Dog sets out to nab Raymond, who robs to support his ice habit, and give him a little Christmas gift - shiny new handcuffs.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When Dog decides to spend the day caring for his newest granddaughter, Beth enlists the girls to hunt down a female fugitive. Heading into a dangerous part of town, the ladies will use their feminine wiles to track this mother gone wrong.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog is trying to cut down on smoking, but it's not easy with his high-stress job. Today, he must track down Walter, a fugitive who believes that the Canadian military has planted a chip in his teeth that allows him to communicate with his van.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog decides it's time to outfit the Da Kine crew with new SUVs. After a quick visit to their local dealership, they go after Jasmine, a woman whose criminal record includes over 37 arrests for everything from drug promotion to assault.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog is hunting a man known as The Godfather of Waikiki. Dog and Beth bailed him out as a courtesy, but now he is refusing to go to court. If Dog doesn't bring him in, it could cost him more than money; he may lose his respect on the street.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog knows that it is better to give than to receive, so when a fellow bondsman grieving for his recently departed spouse requests his help, he jumps into action. While studying the fugitive's file, the team uncovers a surprising fact.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: When Lyssa points out that the fugitive in the next case has the same birth date as Barbara, Dog's recently deceased daughter, the team takes a special vow to capture the young woman.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: For months, this fugitive has been stringing Leland along with a series of barely believable excuses. Out of patience, Leland calls in the Big Dog. The team whole team heads out to put pressure on the family and friends of the fugitive.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog pursues two people whose lives have been ruined by drugs. First, he tracks Mae, who traded a good home and loving family for an ice pipe. The next case involves Jude. His addiction has caused his pregnant wife to fear for her safety.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: In an attempt to bring the team back together, Dog recruits his pastor, Tim Storey, to be the peacemaker. As Dog begins his hunt for a young man who has trouble showing up at court, Tim has his own mission--convince Duane Lee to meet with him.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Christopher is barely 21, who already has a history of domestic abuse and assault, and now he's facing major time in a room without a view. This hunt won't be easy for Dog -- the leads are few, informers and family are not forthcoming.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: The following day is Dog's birthday, but that won't stop him from chasing a fugitive, who is facing firearms charges. Dog doesn't relish the thought of going after an alleged gunslinger on his birthday, but he's never one to avoid a challenge.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog and his posse head to Colorado for a special mission, to catch Marco, an alleged drug dealer. It's been ten months since Marco went on the lam, and his bondsman stands to lose his family business if Marco is not caught.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: With a long record of violence and abuse and weighing in at over 200lbs, Dog's target for the day does not sound like a gentle giant. When the trail grows cold, Dog turns up the heat on the fugitive's brother and sister.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog is back hunting in the big city of Denver, but chasing fugitives on the mainland is more dangerous than ever. So Dog decides that the crew should get pepper-ball guns, which have much better range than pepper spray.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Jim is a bondsman and longtime friend of Dog. Jim's son has just started in the family business. Today Jim has asked Dog to track down a potentially dangerous fugitive, and take his son along for some training with the best in the world.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: With Duane Lee back on the team, the rift in the Chapman clan appears over. But will time heal this wound? As the family heads out for the seedier side of Honolulu in search of an erotic dancer, we will find out if the wound is truly healed.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: This fugitive spells trouble for Dog in today's hunt. When the leads grow cold, it's the US Postal Service to the rescue as a mail carrier lends a helping hand. Dog's team surrounds the suspected safe house and silently awaits their prey.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Dog has a big problem. Patty Estabilio has jumped a $15,000 bail bond and disappeared into Hawaii's underworld. Kissing the kids good night, Dog and Beth, with Tim and Leland at their side, plunge into a drug-infused netherworld.

programme.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Tim's got a big problem. Owen has failed to appear in court. He's on bond for serious drug charges and now Tim could lose $30,000 if he doesn't catch Owen. With Dog's help he tries to track down the co-signer but they come up dry.

programme.title: Mike Paramore
programme.desc: Mike Paramore is the guy you fight to sit next to in a movie theatre, on a long car ride, or during a boring lecture. His natural ability to infuse everyday situations with energetic, uplifting humor, combined with a natural ability to put you at ease is key to his personal brand of comedy. His smooth delivery and? powerful punchlines make him a force in stand-up comedy, which is very apparent in his debut album "The Things We Tell Ourselves", available now on iTunes and Amazon. Mike has opened for comedians like Damon Wayans, Cash Cab's Ben Baily, Jon Lovitz, and Saturday Night Live's Jay Pharoah.

programme.title: Drew Barth
programme.desc: Drew Barth is one of the fastest rising comedy stars in the Northwest. Born just outside the city of Seattle, what started as a dare in high school has become a full-time career. Drew Barth has risen through the ranks of local open mics to become a regular performer at comedy clubs, colleges, casinos and private events up and down the West Coast. After making the finals of the Seattle International Comedy Competition, Drew Barth spent a great deal of time in Los Angeles performing at clubs such as The Comedy Store, Laugh Factory, and The Improv, honing his craft.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Bro'd Trip
programme.desc: Jase accompanies Willie on a business trip to Arkansas to pitch a new product and has unorthodox sales strategies. Back in Monroe, Jep and Si have to track down an important item of Willie's that they accidentally shipped out.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Willie thinks his kids have been spending too much time on their phones and other devices so he initiates a "No-Tech Week," but when he has to participate too it ends up being harder than he thought. There's a lice outbreak at Duck Command.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: The West Monroe Wing
programme.desc: Willie and Jase run against each other to become president of their neighborhood HOA. Jep, Jess and Miss Kay work on a Duck Commander themed display for the local zoo.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Automation Frustration
programme.desc: Willie buys a 3D printer for the office that starts off as a fun distraction for the guys until it appears the printer could soon replace their jobs. Si is upset that Willie invested in the 3D printer and didn't give him a raise.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Razing the Snakes
programme.desc: Jase, Jep, Si and Cole try to fight back a growing population of cottonmouth snakes on Phil's property. Meanwhile, Willie uses his business expertise to help Rebecca improve her clothing store.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Uneasy Rider
programme.desc: Willie puts Little Will on a budget for his first car but it backfires when Will decides to get a motorcycle instead. Jase and the guys are inspired to design a product using zip lines that will revolutionize duck hunting.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Good Willie Hunting
programme.desc: While many of the guys' wives and children are in Africa doing charity work, Willie and Jase get into a debate over tracking ability which leads to a challenge--can Jase and Si track and capture Willie and Jep?

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Sleep Cover
programme.desc: With Korie still in Africa, Willie and Jep must step in and supervise Bella's sleepover. When a couple boys play a prank on the girls, Willie and Jep prove to be the perfect chaperones for the task.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Drive-In Revivin'
programme.desc: Korie challenges Willie to come up with a romantic gesture without spending any money. Missy and Jase compete to see who can find a girlfriend for Mountain Man.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Fishful Thinking
programme.desc: Jase's hopes to win the inaugural Duck Commander Fishing Tournament is buoyed when he is able to enlist the help of legendary angler Bill Dance. Meanwhile, Willie's vanity over his greying beard leads him to make a questionable decision.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: When Doves Fry
programme.desc: Jase and Jep make a deal with Mia and Merritt to get them to go dove hunting with them. Si tries to make some extra cash by starting a West Monroe tour.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Carpnado
programme.desc: Jumping Asian carp have invaded Monroe's waters so Jase and the guys set out to try to stop them from spreading further. Meanwhile, Willie and Si have to run Willie's Duck Diner for the day.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: The Campfire Diaries
programme.desc: The family spends a weekend at their childhood summer camp, reliving old memories and working to repair a tennis court Willie built twenty years ago. While at the camp, Jep tries to pass a lifeguard swimming test he failed as a teenager.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Rowdy's Big Day
programme.desc: Rowdy's adoption is finalized and he officially becomes a Robertson. Jase gets his first massage and enjoys it more than he expected.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Disappearing Acts
programme.desc: After Willie and Jase lose Si's tea cup, Si makes them go to great lengths to find it. When the entertainment for Gus's 1st birthday party falls through, Jep fills in as a magician.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Dance Dads
programme.desc: Willie, Korie, Jase and Missy take dance lessons from Sadie to prepare for Reed and Rebecca's upcoming weddings. Jase's plan to perform Reed's wedding ceremony may fall through when he waits until the last minute to renew his ordainment.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: End of an Era
programme.desc: When Si decides to retire to pursue a music career, the family organizes a party in his honor. Meanwhile, Willie, Phil, and Jase take a road trip to try to recreate an old duck call for Si's retirement gift.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Looking Back and Talking Quack
programme.desc: The Robertson family takes a look back at 130 episodes of Duck Dynasty.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: The Grass & The Furious
programme.desc: It's all hands on deck for the Duckmen when an old high school nemesis challenges them to a good old-fashioned race.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Driving Miss Sadie
programme.desc: With Sadie's driver's license test fast approaching, she finds herself in dire need of lessons. Willie, Jase and Si each set out to correct her glaring failures behind the wheel by teaching her how to drive... Robertson-style.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Truck Commander
programme.desc: After Willie's son, John Luke, leaves Willie's pickup in the driveway with a bone-dry gas tank, Willie and Korie decide that it's time to get the kid his own car.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Si-Yonara
programme.desc: The Duck Commander assembly room gets an unexpected shakeup when a disgruntled Si decides to quit his job.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Fowl Play
programme.desc: Willie finds his office in shambles and alerts the authorities that the warehouse has had a break in.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Sweatin' Bullets
programme.desc: When a heat wave envelops West Monroe the air conditioning unit at the Duck Commander warehouse goes down, turning the duck call assembly room into a boiling sweatshop.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Spring Pong Cleaning
programme.desc: After Korie decides the junk piles in the Duck Commander warehouse are beginning to reach critical mass, she calls on Willie and the guys to do a little company spring-cleaning.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Good Morning, West Monroe
programme.desc: After attending a local radio show as a guest, Willie sees an opportunity to host a show of his own.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Of Mattresses and Men
programme.desc: The Jase, Si and the guys from the duck call room take a field trip to a brand new local donut shop and quickly find out who amongst them can eat the most delicious treats.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Samurai Si
programme.desc: Willie receives a special gift from a Japanese business associate - a "priceless" samurai sword, which Willie keeps out of the hands of Jase and the guys.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck No, We Won't Go
programme.desc: Willie pushes his work force too far after implementing new "motivational work tactics," and the guys rise up against him and go on strike.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Drag Me To Glory
programme.desc: When NASCAR sensation Clint Bowyer pays a visit to the Duck Commander warehouse, Willie and the guys are fired up to spend the day hanging out with the professional racecar driver.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Season Eve
programme.desc: Tomorrow is the opening day of Duck Season and the men are carrying on their tradition of camping on the Robertson Land the night before.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Can't Hardly Weight
programme.desc: Gearing up for his high school reunion, Willie realizes that he could stand to lose a few pounds. Jase and Korie set out to help him drop some weight and the strenuous battle of man-versus-waistline begins.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Shot Thru The Heart
programme.desc: The guys learn from Willie that John Luke is going through his first break up. In order to make him feel better the men decide to take John Luke hunting for nutria, and impart their relationship wisdom.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Here Lizard, Lizard
programme.desc: When the warehouse guys new office pet (a lizard) escapes, they try all they can in order to catch the wily reptile. Proving impossible, the guys finally decide to bring in the big guns to help trap it--Mr. Phil Robertson.

programme.title: American Mystery: American Mystery
programme.desc: Experts may have finally identified the strange creatures that besieged a Kentucky farmhouse new evidence could explain the largest mass UFO sighting in U.S. history investigators seek answers in Chicago's O'Hare International Airport sighting.

programme.title: Alien Corridors

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) consigue un trabajo como limpiadora en el colegio de sus hijos. Cuando las amigas Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) comienzan a ridiculizar a la limpiadora, ella no se inmuta para que no descubran que es su madre y Aída decide darle un escarmiento Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) y Luisma (Paco León) deciden que es hora de que Chema (Pepe Viyuela) encuentre pareja, así que recurren a una agencia de contactos. Toni Colmenero (Secun de la Rosa) visita a su hermano Mauricio (Mariano Peña), quien siempre le repudió por ser homosexual. Un malentendido hace que Mauricio cambie de actitud con su hermano

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) comienza a estudiar para prepararse para ser secretaria, pero integrarse en el grupo de chicas con las que estudia no será una tarea fácil Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) está empezando a tocar el violín cuando se sorprende al ver el talento que tiene Jonathan (David Castillo) para este instrumento. Remedios (Cristina Peña), la prima de Paz (Melanie Olivares), viene de visita y habrá que ocultarle la profesión de su prima. Luisma (Paco León) intenta conquista a la guapa y puritana prima de Paz.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) quiere impresionar a los nuevos vecinos que se han instalado en su edificio, pero la tarea no va bien y acaba teniendo un problema con el padre de la familia. Luisma (Paco León) anima a Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) a que se presente a un concurso de televisión y demostrar sus artes en la música y el baile. Mauricio (Mariano Peña) decide irse de su casa tras discutir con su madre. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) lo acoge en su hogar pero no tardará en arrepentirse

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Aída (Carmen Machi) piensa que su hija Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) está embarazada, y Paz (Melanie Olivares) se siente culpable Desde que comparte con Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso) sus sesiones de bingo, Mauricio (Mariano Peña) tiene suerte, así que está encantado de su compañía en el juego, pero Eugenia cree que sus intenciones son otras muy distintas. Jonathan (David Castillo) cumple trabajos sociales acompañando a pasear a un anciano. Su amigo Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) le apoya en la tarea. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) es consciente de que fue él quien le ofreció a Luisma (Paco León) su primer porro, y ahora piensa que por su culpa fue drogadicto. Dicho cargo de conciencia hará que Chema intente recompensarle por el daño hecho.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Una serie de circunstancias provocan que Chema se sienta culpable por la muerte de un enfermo terminal.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una diva, un faisán y un piso que cuesta un riñón
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que el padre del novio de su hijo es un acaudalado jeque del petróleo, Antonio decide organizar la boda de ambos jóvenes e invita al magnate al enlace para asociarse con él. La situación se complica cuando el presidente de Mirador de Montepinar descubre que el multimillonario árabe ignora que su hijo es homosexual, circunstancia que constituye un grave delito en su país.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una sugarbaby,un filet muñón y un diógenes exprés
programme.desc: Amador presenta a Yoli a su nueva novia, Oli, con la que pretende darle celos. Ella es una joven universitaria que trabaja como 'sugar baby' para sacarse un dinero a mayores. Por otra parte, Antonio Recio, que confía en su propio instinto empresarial, pretende convencer a Enrique para abrir juntos un restaurante. Para garantizar el éxito de su idea, convienen contratar a un excéntrico chef, que se pondrá al frente de la cocina del establecimiento. Vicente está desconsolado desde que su amigo Fermín se ha ido a vivir con Menchu. Javi se encargará de ayudarle a recuperar a su compañero. Mientras tanto, Bruno continúa con los preliminares de su relación con Maite y trata de persuadirla de la importancia de mantener un romance espiritual. La Cuqui se verá obligada a calmar su deseo con otro hombre, ante la carencia de relaciones íntimas con su amado.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una conserja, un romance imposible y un cuesco traicionero
programme.desc: Fermín se ve en la obligación de contratar a la sobrina de Menchu para cubrir la vacante temporal de conserje. A pesar de los esfuerzos de Clara por contentar a los propietarios, al padre de Lola no será capaz de convencerlo de su valía. Amador persuade a Teodoro para que vigile a Yoli. Alba y Enrique comienzan una relación en secreto mientras que los padres de ella pretenden descubrir quién es el nuevo novio de su hija. Vicente, triste por la marcha de Fermín, se refugia con su hijo y su nuera. Chusa, respaldándose en su embarazo, desatiende sus funciones de asistenta.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una presidenta capacitista, un mayorista deconstruido y un intercambio epistolar
programme.desc: La vida se ha complicado para Agustín y Amador desde que se han mudado al edificio de Contubernio 49. Ambos se unirán en la cruzada de buscar la manera de que la comunidad instale un ascensor en el inmueble. Mientras tanto, Bruno finge estar enfermo para tratar de eludir el acoso de la marquesa Victoria Rafaela, pero ella no se da por vencida. Por otra parte, cuando Berta encuentra trabajo obliga a Antonio a que deje a un lado su plan de reflotar su imperio empresarial y se haga cargo de las tareas de la casa.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un desfibrilador, un bolardo y una pataleta adolescente
programme.desc: Antonio Recio está empeñado en recuperar su imperio empresarial y para conseguirlo necesita que alguien le respalde. Mientras Berta está ocupada con su nuevo trabajo, Recio descubre que la relación con su suegra ha mejorado y cree que es el mejor momento para proponerle que lo ayude con su negocio. Por otra parte, la tensión entre Greta y su hija Julia llega a un punto álgido cuando la farmacéutica no le da permiso para que vaya a un concierto. Sin embargo, la adolescente no está dispuesta a perderse el recital ni a perdonar a su madre.

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: Argel, Nueva Orleans, un ferry lleno de marineros y sus familiares explota dejando tras de si más de quinientas víctimas. El caso es asignado al agente Doug, al que también informan de la muerte de una mujer que falleció una hora antes del atentado por la acción del mismo tipo de dispositivo. A raíz de este descubrimiento, Doug es invitado por el agente del FBI Pryzwarra a unirse a un equipo de vigilancia que utiliza una ventana temporal para observar lo ocurrido cuatro días atrás. Doug acepta y descubre la identidad de la joven. Pero acaba enamorándose de ella y trata por todos los medios de librarla de su fatal destino. El actor Jim Caviezel decidió, en el último momento, trabajar como su propio doble en la escena del choque de autos. Por poco no quedó paralítico. Toda la película utiliza recursos de la anterior cinta de Tonny Scott,.'Enemigo Público'. Jim Caviezel ya había trabajado con anterioridad en otra película que trataba los viajes al pasado o al futuro, su título es 'Frecuency', en la que comparte protagonismo con el actor Dennis Quaid. La película fue nominada en la categoría de 'mejor película' por la Academia de películas de Ciencia Ficción, Fantasía y Terror de Estados Unidos.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un reencuentro, un desalojo y un torneo de paddle
programme.desc: Izaskun y Mari Tere, ocultas en el cuarto de basuras, esperan a que Raquel, Joaquín y Eric concluyan su jornada de trabajo para acceder al piso piloto y pasar allí la noche. Cuando constatan que ya no queda nadie en la vivienda, se introducen en ella. Sin embargo, las dos okupas ignoran que los empleados de la compañía se han entretenido charlando en la puerta de entrada. Raquel se percata entonces de que las dos ancianas se encuentran dentro de la casa y les exige que la abandonen. Ante la negativa de ambas mujeres, la directora comercial llama a la policía y las amigas dejan de ser okupas nocturnas para serlo a jornada completa. Para poder seguir vendiendo la segunda fase del ''Mirador de Montepinar'' sin problemas, Raquel, Joaquín y Eric llevan a cabo distintas iniciativas para que Izaskun y Mari Tere cambien su lugar de residencia.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un coche eléctrico, una chacha literata y una sopa de dedo agridulce
programme.desc: La vida sonríe a los Cuquis: Maite triunfa como escritora de novela erótica, mientras Amador disfruta de la dolce vita como "hombre mantenido". Han ascendido en la escala social y muchos de sus sueños se han hecho realidad. La felicidad de ambos será plena tras recuperar definitivamente la custodia de sus cuatro hijos, emotivo reencuentro que tendrá lugar mientras a Maite se le acaba el plazo para entregar su segunda novela a la editorial. Entretanto, Coque, decidido a dar un paso adelante en su relación con Nines, pide a su novia que se case con él, propuesta a la que ella accede siempre que ambos pasen por el altar con una boda por todo lo alto. Tras conocer la noticia, Antonio y Fermín se ofrecen, cada uno por su cuenta, a ayudar al conserje a conseguir un anillo de pedida. Por otra parte, Judith, que se ha sometido a una operación de reconstrucción de himen, está decidida a perder su virginidad con alguien especial. Además, Enrique Pastor, fiel defensor de los principios ecológicos, estrena coche eléctrico, iniciativa que suscita los celos y la envidia entre los habitantes de Mirador de Montepinar.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un cromo de Iniesta, unos payasos justicieros...
programme.desc: Una huelga en el servicio de recogida de basuras provoca el caos y la indignación en Mirador de Montepinar. Amador se obsesiona en completar la colección de cromos de la Liga de Fútbol Profesional.
